summary: Describes what to keep out of the video.
combines: Lixpi sends a constant here, never anything the user wrote.

Documented on Vertex and exposed by the SDK on the Gemini path, but the Gemini Veo parameter table does not list it. Lixpi sends a fixed string here today without documented confirmation that Gemini honours it.

usage.from: state.videoGenerationConfig.negativePrompt, populated from the VEO_NEGATIVE_PROMPT constant in llm/tools/video-generation-trace.ts:12
usage.what: A fixed house string of things to keep out of every clip. No user text ever reaches this field.

note: It must be populated based on what reasoning model decides to put there based on user's input. User may also provide explicit negative prompt, then it must be used as is
